frozen_cases.setup: Real temporary Git repository: two task commits and actual accepted producer output; independent expectation captured before collector output is read except the separately captured result/manifest digests. Invoke packaged verifier.
frozen_cases.frozen_expectation: Exit 0/binding_status matched only for exact task/owner/generation/repo/base/head/source and valid actual package; output explicitly review_status not_assessed. Findings.v1 target for subsequent range review is kind branch, comparison range, exact endpoints, null snapshot, committed only.
frozen_cases.required_evidence: Real helper stdout/exit; producer and verifier hashes; expectation/ref/source provenance; actual artifact hashes. No review verdict asserted.
frozen_cases.source_handoff_observations: Actual matching helper/replay test passed. No actual review verdict asserted.

frozen_cases.setup: Parameterize one changed expectation/manifest field: task ID, owner, generation, repository ID/local identity/format, base, head, spec/plan hash including null mismatch, source hash. Recompute package-local hashes in the adversarial copy; keep independent expectation immutable.
frozen_cases.frozen_expectation: Verifier rejects before any finding is read; self-consistent altered package cannot establish expected identity. A manifest-hash mismatch is sufficient rejection; second variants update only trusted-channel receipt in controlled fixture to exercise independent field comparisons.
frozen_cases.required_evidence: Each fault-fired assertion, nonzero verifier result and error code, unchanged expected-file digest; no automatic expected renewal.
frozen_cases.source_handoff_observations: Subject/range/repository/spec/plan/source-pin negatives passed; not every frozen manifest variant exercised.

frozen_cases.setup: Advance expected candidate branch after capture, then test staged change, unstaged tracked change and nonignored untracked file with unchanged HEAD; separately exercise sparse/skip-worktree/assume-unchanged flags and an initial unrelated dirty file.
frozen_cases.frozen_expectation: Moved current ref or unsupported hidden-index state rejects. Current-candidate handoff with superproject dirty state is unavailable/rejected, not relabeled committed; use separately bound dirty snapshot. Ordinary commit review defaults remain unchanged. Unrelated dirty content stays intact.
frozen_cases.required_evidence: Actual Git status/index/ref observations before/after; verifier failure; no checkout/stage/reset writes.
frozen_cases.source_handoff_observations: Moved HEAD, staged/unstaged/untracked, sparse/skip/assume fault cases passed and preserved contents; all broader submodule variants not run.

frozen_cases.setup: Missing/partial/incomplete package, decorated/duplicate-key result, extra JSON fields, absent or edited blob, hash-corrupt raw commit, out-of-root/symlink/hardlink artifact, unexpected file, manifest.partial, replaced directory, changed expected/source during verification.
frozen_cases.frozen_expectation: Read-only verifier rejects or returns unverified with nonzero status; never follows unsafe paths or rewrites package. Input hashes and sentinels unchanged.
frozen_cases.required_evidence: Actual file/descriptor checks plus bounded fault seams confirming mutation occurred; no simulated success payload.
frozen_cases.source_handoff_observations: Artifact/protocol/symlink/hardlink/partial/rehashed diff and final expectation mutation passed; full frozen race/malformed-object matrix not yet run.

frozen_cases.setup: Produce package, mutate trusted owner script/schema/map without replacing independent expected hashes, then collect fresh output after independently approving and recapturing new source binding. Also mutate net diff/list content with internally recomputed hashes.
frozen_cases.frozen_expectation: Old source binding fails; fresh independently captured generation/source and newly collected package can match. Replay from expected endpoints rejects internally consistent omitted earlier commit/diff or malformed object/path mapping. No value is learned from untrusted manifest.
frozen_cases.required_evidence: Old/new source hash records, rejected stale and successful fresh actual runs; no source-change effectiveness claim.
frozen_cases.source_handoff_observations: Actual changed owner source rejects prior pin; explicit caller-selected fresh source/new collection matches; omitted-list replay fault not yet separately exercised.

frozen_cases.setup: Give an actual separate reviewer an invalid package and a path to findings without its contents; then a valid two-commit package with introduced defect and unchanged caller, and a clean matched control.
frozen_cases.frozen_expectation: Invalid binding blocks findings consumption. Valid collection alone is not review: reviewer reads bound diff/source and material unchanged caller, reports verified introduced cause/consumer in defect case, invents none in control; missing Findings or unread material remains incomplete/unverifiable. Final branch/GitOps gates remain open.
frozen_cases.required_evidence: Actual reviewer context/tool-delivery trace, exact input/resource hashes, resulting Findings.v1 and independent assessment against frozen defect/control. String checks or a fake reviewer object are insufficient.
frozen_cases.source_handoff_observations: Unrun actual separate reviewer defect/control and invalid-package findings-consumption trace.

frozen_cases.evidence_class: actual diagnostic observation and independent causal assessment
frozen_cases.setup: Frozen deterministic expiry fixture: accepted contract rejects when now>=expiry; subject uses now>expiry. Two hypotheses: boundary comparison versus parser/clock-input discrepancy. Observe one tick before/equal/after using fixed parsed integer inputs and inspect parser output/source contrast.
frozen_cases.frozen_expectation: Identified comparison cause only when observed boundary contrast plus inspected values rules out the parser alternative in the fixture scope. Before remains accepted; equal/after rejected is proposed regression oracle. Receipt carries unchanged behavior, scoped uncertainty, qualitative confidence rationale in hypothesis result/conclusion and references to actual observations.
frozen_cases.required_evidence: Actual frozen fixture execution records and source hashes; diagnosis author receipt; separate reviewer causal assessment identifies relevant alternatives and why discriminator is sufficient. No schema-derived cause verdict.
frozen_cases.source_handoff_observations: Actual fixed-input source/parser/expiry observations and author receipt; independent causal assessment pending.

frozen_cases.setup: Frozen replay fixture models a timing-dependent reported failure; captured failure trace lacks causal ordering discriminator. Run a finite recorded all-pass schedule of three controlled exposures with unchanged source and no distinguishing trace. Label synthetic schedule as fixture input, not natural failure-rate evidence.
frozen_cases.frozen_expectation: cause_status unknown; timing and shared-state explanations unresolved; all three successes preserved as exposure, never fixed or identified. State missing ordering observation and bounded next step.
frozen_cases.required_evidence: Actual attempts/exits/log hashes; independent reviewer rejects a supplied plausible identified/fixed counterexample even if it satisfies structural schema.
frozen_cases.source_handoff_observations: Actual bounded synthetic all-pass exposures and unknown author receipt; independent counterexample rejection pending.

frozen_cases.setup: Reported failure lacks required fixture input; read-only inspection cannot reconstruct it, and requested live reset/log secret dump is outside diagnosis authority. No repair or mutating reproduction is performed.
frozen_cases.frozen_expectation: Unknown cause, no invented observation/exit, supplied report marked reported; missing input and safe next discriminator explicit. No candidate diff requirement or forced code review; no takeover of incident coordination.
frozen_cases.required_evidence: Actual accessible evidence/attempt or unavailable prerequisite records; before/after source/active-state sentinel hashes; redacted receipt and independent causal/authority assessment.
frozen_cases.source_handoff_observations: Actual frozen missing-input inspection and unknown author receipt; no reproduction exit invented, independent authority assessment pending.

frozen_cases.setup: From H-D1 reviewed receipt, separately authorize bounded expiry repair via the current host ordinary implementation worker applying D5 directly, no Batman. Provide exact input receipt/log hashes, allowed paths, unchanged behavior and stop before commit. Preserve a distinct dirty sentinel.
frozen_cases.frozen_expectation: Worker uses actual source/test stack, observes focused failure then pass, changes only authorized code/test/docs, retains before/equal/after behavior and dirty sentinel, returns exact dirty snapshot SliceReceipt. Diagnosis alone never supplied authority.
frozen_cases.required_evidence: Actual worker identity/context/source/resource bytes, authorization reference, commands/outputs, receipt, diff/snapshot and separate reviewer result. Template/shape checks do not satisfy this case.
frozen_cases.source_handoff_observations: Unrun separately authorized ordinary worker repair/context/receipt and independent review.

frozen_cases.setup: Existing feedback IDs A/B/C/D have decisions accepted/rejected/deferred/unselected with source and authority refs. Authorize only A; bounded worker applies A and returns, while review-fix keeps original ledger.
frozen_cases.frozen_expectation: All IDs and initial decisions survive; A outcome addressed only with repair evidence, rejected B/deferred C/unselected D not implemented. Accepted-but-unfinished variant remains unresolved/deferred with reason. No hosted thread is closed or message posted by handoff.
frozen_cases.required_evidence: Actual before/after code, review-fix selection/outcome table, SliceReceipt comment_dispositions, independent scope review; distinguish decision from outcome.
frozen_cases.source_handoff_observations: Unrun actual selected-feedback worker/outcome reconciliation observation.

frozen_cases.setup: One required test runner absent; another wrapper returns zero but emits no underlying result. A documentation-only control has a scoped diff/link inspection request and no test need.
frozen_cases.frozen_expectation: Missing runner unavailable/null exit/reason; wrapper process success does not make intended tests passed. Put unknown intended-test execution/result in unverified and omit its checks entry; use not_run only when non-execution is established. Separately describe actual wrapper exit. Docs-only control uses proportionate inspection with no mandatory full suite/commit/JSON/Batman.
frozen_cases.required_evidence: Actual observed tool absence/wrapper stdout-exit and receipt; independent reviewer confirms no invented intended-test result.
frozen_cases.source_handoff_observations: Unrun actual missing-tool/deceptive wrapper/prose-only worker observations.

frozen_cases.setup: Explicitly authorized bounded Batman fixture uses its actual controller with a current task node/owner/generation and separate implementation and review contexts; replay one stale worker result and one missing independent review.
frozen_cases.frozen_expectation: Same TaskContract bytes reach worker with separate controller envelope; controller authors no implementation/test/fix, cannot self-review, rejects stale/missing result and preserves all existing milestone/attacker/landing requirements. Successful bounded task observation does not claim entire Batman delivery or native-provider coverage.
frozen_cases.required_evidence: Actual host context/tool author trace and current-generation gate records; existing structural Batman tests supplemental only. If independent contexts unavailable, acceptance stays incomplete.
frozen_cases.source_handoff_observations: Unrun explicitly authorized actual Batman controller/separate implementer/reviewer contexts.

frozen_cases.evidence_class: executable canonical import and detached package
frozen_cases.setup: Declare single current D7 test-oracles-v1 import into D5, build normally, copy/select only generated D5 package into disposable independent installation with no D7 sibling, load verification route via its bundled loader.
frozen_cases.frozen_expectation: D5 receives byte-identical oracle guidance with source_path attributed to D7 and valid detached receipt; no authored D5 oracle file or sibling lookup; receipt route still works.
frozen_cases.required_evidence: Actual generator/import validation, detached loader output/hashes and single-selected disposable installation result; no live home writes.
frozen_cases.source_handoff_observations: Canonical import and detached selected D5 loader/receipt passed without D7 sibling. Normal generator/disposable installer step remains root integration obligation.

frozen_cases.setup: Mutate owner oracle after import hash freeze; attempt canonical load/generation/evaluator preflight. Separately test copied consumer byte tamper, source ownership change, missing import receipt, shadow authored D5 file, dependency cycle and transitive source re-export.
frozen_cases.frozen_expectation: Canonical stale import/binding fails; evaluator makes no call on drift. Existing detached old package remains internally valid but cannot claim current owner freshness; new generation changes effective D5 binding. Tampered detached copy and unsafe closure fail.
frozen_cases.required_evidence: Actual existing registry/loader/evaluator paths with fault-fired checks; old/new bundle hashes, no sibling runtime fetch.
frozen_cases.source_handoff_observations: Actual canonical owner drift and detached tamper tested; existing registry finite-closure/evaluator negatives passed. Renewed generated/evaluator bindings pending integration.

frozen_cases.setup: Use imported reference to design before/equal/after expiry checks; an authorized D5 test fixture exercises faulty > and corrected >= behavior. Challenge a mock-call-only redeemed-token test.
frozen_cases.frozen_expectation: Boundary assertion distinguishes faulty behavior and valid control; actual independent reviewer rejects mock choreography as redemption proof. TestDesign.v1 remains not_run even when separate D5 execution evidence exists; reference-alone consumers do not assume TestDesign schema installation.
frozen_cases.required_evidence: Real focused faulty/correct behavior outputs plus independent oracle assessment, separate TestDesign/SliceReceipt evidence classes.
frozen_cases.source_handoff_observations: Actual faulty/correct synthetic boundary assertions; independent meaningful-oracle and mock-only challenge judgments pending.
